questions.question: Scrum là gì và 3 roles trong Scrum?

options.B: Scrum: agile framework. 3 roles: Scrum Master (facilitator), Product Owner (backlog, vision), Development Team (self-organizing, cross-functional)

questions.explanation: Scrum: iterative, incremental framework. 3 roles: (1) Scrum Master: ensure Scrum is understood, remove impediments, NOT a PM. (2) Product Owner: maximize product value, manage backlog, single wringable neck. (3) Development Team: 3-9 people, self-organizing, cross-functional (no sub-teams). Scrum events: Sprint (1-4 weeks), Sprint Planning, Daily Scrum (15 min standup), Sprint Review, Sprint Retrospective. Artifacts: Product Backlog, Sprint Backlog, Increment.

questions.question: Agile Manifesto — 4 values và 12 principles?

options.B: 4 values: Individuals over processes, Working software over docs, Customer collaboration over negotiation, Responding to change over following a plan

questions.explanation: Agile Manifesto (2001): 4 values — (1) Individuals and interactions OVER processes and tools. (2) Working software OVER comprehensive documentation. (3) Customer collaboration OVER contract negotiation. (4) Responding to change OVER following a plan. Key word: value left MORE, không dismiss right. 12 principles: customer satisfaction, welcome change, frequent delivery, business + dev collaboration, motivated individuals, face-to-face, working software = progress, sustainable pace, technical excellence, simplicity, self-organizing teams, regular reflection.

questions.question: User Story format và Acceptance Criteria?

options.B: As a [user], I want [feature], So that [benefit]. Acceptance Criteria: Given-When-Then (BDD). INVEST: Independent, Negotiable, Valuable, Estimable, Small, Testable
options.D: AC không cần cho small stories

questions.explanation: User Story: As a returning customer, I want to save my payment info, So that I can checkout faster. Must have: Who (role), What (feature), Why (benefit/value). Acceptance Criteria: Given I have saved a card, When I click 'Use saved card', Then my order is placed without re-entering card details. INVEST criteria: Independent (can be developed alone), Negotiable (details can change), Valuable (delivers value), Estimable (team can size it), Small (fits in sprint), Testable (clear done criteria). Story Points: relative effort estimation, not hours. Definition of Done: what 'done' means for the team.

questions.question: Sprint Planning, Daily Scrum, Sprint Review, Retrospective — mục đích của mỗi ceremony?

options.A: Tất cả chỉ là meeting không cần thiết
options.B: Planning: what & how sprint. Daily Scrum: sync, 15 min. Review: demo to stakeholders. Retrospective: team improvement. Mỗi ceremony có mục đích rõ ràng
options.D: Review và Retro là cùng meeting

questions.explanation: Sprint Planning (2-4h): Team + PO chọn backlog items, tạo Sprint Goal, decompose tasks. Daily Scrum (15 min, dev team only): 3 questions truyền thống → không required, focus: inspect progress toward Sprint Goal. Sprint Review (2h): demo increment, gather feedback từ stakeholders, update backlog. Sprint Retrospective (1.5h): team reflection — What went well? What to improve? Action items (1-3 actionable improvements). Scrum Master facilitates. Anti-pattern: blame game, no action items, skipping retro.

questions.question: Kanban vs Scrum — khi nào chọn cái nào?

options.B: Scrum: iterations (sprints), roles, events — tốt cho product development. Kanban: continuous flow, WIP limits, visualize work — tốt cho support/ops/maintenance

questions.explanation: Scrum: time-boxed (sprint), committed backlog, velocity metric, 3 roles mandatory. Good for: new product development, clear sprint goals, predictable cadence. Kanban: continuous flow, no sprints (but can have cadences), WIP limits (prevent overload), Lead Time / Cycle Time metrics, pull-based. Good for: support teams, ops, maintenance, unpredictable work. Scrumban: hybrid. Metrics: Scrum velocity, Kanban throughput + lead time, CFD (Cumulative Flow Diagram). SAFe, LeSS, Nexus: scaled agile frameworks.

questions.question: Backlog refinement và story point estimation?

options.B: Team-based: Planning Poker (consensus), T-shirt sizing, story splitting (INVEST). Velocity (avg pts/sprint) cho sprint planning. Reference stories để calibrate
options.C: Hour-based estimation là chính xác hơn

questions.explanation: Backlog refinement (grooming): ongoing, < 10% sprint capacity. Goals: stories clear, estimated, ordered. Planning Poker: each member vote independently (Fibonacci: 1,2,3,5,8,13,21,?). Extremes discuss → consensus. Reference story: 'feature X = 5 points' làm baseline. Story splitting: SPIDR (Spike, Path, Interface, Data, Rules). Avoid: hour estimation (inaccurate, creates false precision), 1 person estimates for all. Velocity: average completed story points/sprint. Use for planning, not as performance metric. No estimates (#NoEstimates) movement.

questions.question: Sprint failed — team không deliver Sprint Goal. Postmortem?

options.B: Blameless retrospective: analyze why (overcommitted, impediments, scope creep, unclear requirements), action items, adjust velocity, communicate to stakeholders

questions.explanation: Sprint failure analysis: (1) Overcommitted: velocity history không accurate, high uncertainty stories. Fix: use velocity data, add buffer, time-box spikes. (2) Impediments not removed: Scrum Master failed to escalate, blocked dependencies. Fix: impediment log, daily escalation. (3) Scope creep: PO added stories during sprint. Fix: clear Sprint Goal, PO cannot change committed backlog. (4) Unclear requirements: stories refined insufficiently. Fix: better Definition of Ready. (5) Technical debt slowed progress. Fix: allocate 20% capacity for tech debt. Communication: transparent với stakeholders, không hide failures.
